subject: Civic Education
competence: Contributes to minimize accidents and disasters by identifying them.
unique_learning_outcome: Explains the causes for disasters and accidents.
Suggests measures to minimize the damages caused by accidents and disasters.
Shows the measures to be taken to avoid accidents.
Names the institutions that can support in disasters and accidents.
Explains the importance of following instructions given by the institutions that provide support in disasters and accidents.
the_entrance: Introduction to the concept of accidents and disasters, and their impact on society.

lesson_development_steps.teacher_activities: Exposition on the concept of accidents and disasters, and their causes.
Facilitating student group discussions on the causes and effects of accidents and disasters.
lesson_development_steps.assessment_and_feedback: Monitoring group progress and correcting misconceptions.

lesson_development_steps.teacher_activities: Guiding student presentations on the measures to minimize the damages caused by accidents and disasters.
lesson_development_steps.student_activities: Presenting group outcomes and comparing notes.

lesson_development_steps.assessment_and_feedback: Summative check for all learning outcomes.

summary: Recap of key findings and core principles.
assessment_and_feedback_whole_lesson: Summative check or exit questions addressing all learning outcomes.
